# General Requirements Quality Checklist: Captura periódica de noticias con retención acotada y detección de pérdidas

**Purpose**: Chequeo liviano de autor, con cobertura pareja de las 22 FR y 7 SC de spec.md,
antes de avanzar a `/speckit-implement`. No verifica implementación — evalúa si los
requirements en sí están completos, claros, consistentes y medibles.
**Created**: 2026-07-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (ver también [plan.md](../plan.md) y [tasks.md](../tasks.md))

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the exact set of fields persisted per news item exhaustively enumerated with
      no open-ended "etc."? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for what happens to an entry that lacks a required field
      (e.g., no enlace/link at all)? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK003 Is the ingestor's boundary with the not-yet-built endpoint/notifier components
      explicitly documented as out of scope, not just implied by omission? [Completeness, Spec
      §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK004 Is "período prolongado" (ausencia de categoría objetivo) specified as elapsed
      time, run count, or left ambiguous between the two? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK005 Is "alarma distinguible de la operación normal" — used across multiple FRs — given
      one common, concrete shape, or does each FR imply a different signal format? [Clarity,
      Ambiguity]
- [x] CHK006 Does FR-009 (retención debe cubrir el cruce de día local) give an operator any
      lower-bound guidance for choosing the retention value, or is it left entirely to
      judgment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK007 Do FR-013 and FR-022 consistently read as the same underlying signal after the
      clarification added to spec.md, with no leftover wording implying two separate alarms?
      [Consistency, Spec §FR-013/FR-022]
- [x] CHK008 Do the Key Entities in spec.md and the collections in data-model.md agree on which
      fields are feature-facing business data versus internal bookkeeping (e.g., `state`,
      `locks`)? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK009 Can SC-001 ("100% de las noticias objetivo reflejadas") be verified from outside
      the ingestor's internals, purely by comparing source content to stored content?
      [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK010 Is SC-005 ("detectado dentro de la misma corrida") measurable independent of how
      long a single run happens to take? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage / Edge Cases

- [x] CHK011 Beyond the alarm-suppression rule in FR-013, are there any other requirements
      that behave differently on the system's very first run versus subsequent ones?
      [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Are requirements defined for a source response that is well-formed XML but not a
      valid Atom feed (wrong schema, not just malformed markup)? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK013 Are requirements defined for the case where the target category is renamed by the
      source AND a coincidentally-named different category also produces zero matches in the
      same window? [Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK014 Is there any requirement bounding how long a single run may take, to avoid two
      cron-triggered invocations overlapping before the lock is even relevant? [Gap,
      Non-Functional]
- [x] CHK015 Is "acotado" (bounded), used to describe the raw-snapshot diagnostic retention
      period, quantified anywhere, or left entirely to configuration with no guidance?
      [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK016 Is the assumption that the source's category name in the link path is always
      parseable and consistently formatted validated anywhere, or only asserted as a given?
      [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK017 Is the dependency on MongoDB Atlas' free-tier storage limits interacting with the
      retention period referenced anywhere in the requirements, or left entirely to
      operational judgment? [Dependency, Gap]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK018 Is a requirement/acceptance-criteria ID scheme consistently applied across
      spec.md (FR-/SC-) and referenced from tasks.md, so any task can be traced back to the
      requirement it satisfies? [Traceability]
- [x] CHK019 Does spec.md itself note, anywhere a reader would see it without reading plan.md,
      that retention in this feature is time-only (no delivery-awareness yet), so a reader of
      spec.md alone isn't misled about Article I being fully satisfied? [Consistency, Spec
      §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK020 Are there any remaining requirements using vague, unquantified terms ("suficiente",
      "acotado", "prolongado") without an explicit note that the concrete value is deferred to
      configuration? [Ambiguity]

## Notes

- Alcance elegido: cobertura general y pareja de spec.md, en modo chequeo liviano de autor
  (no es un gate formal de release).
- Varios de estos items (CHK004, CHK006, CHK014, CHK015, CHK017, CHK019, CHK020) señalan
  vaguedad ya aceptada deliberadamente como "parámetro de configuración fuera de esta
  especificación" (ver spec.md §Assumptions) — no son necesariamente defectos, pero vale
  confirmarlo explícitamente antes de implementar.
- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments or findings inline
